characters.name: Peter Benjamin Parker
characters.quote: With great power there must also come—great responsibility!
characters.biography: Bitten by a radioactive spider during a science demonstration, high school prodigy Peter Parker gained the proportional strength, agility, and instincts of an arachnid. Initially seeking fame and fortune, Peter learned a devastating lesson in humility and duty when a burglar he casually refused to stop murdered his beloved Uncle Ben. From that tragic moment forward, Peter dedicated his life to using his abilities to protect the innocent, navigating the treacherous dual burdens of being a costumed hero and maintaining a normal personal life in New York City.

keyStorylines.title: If This Be My Destiny...!
keyStorylines.synopsis: Trapped under tons of collapsed steel machinery while his Aunt May faces death, Peter summons every ounce of physical and spiritual willpower to lift the impossible weight.

keyStorylines.title: The Night Gwen Stacy Died
keyStorylines.synopsis: A defining watershed moment in comic book history where the Green Goblin hurls Gwen Stacy off the George Washington Bridge, forever shifting comic storytelling into a darker era.

keyStorylines.title: Kraven's Last Hunt
keyStorylines.synopsis: Kraven the Hunter incapacitates Spider-Man, buries him alive, and dons his costume to prove himself superior, triggering a psychological descent into obsession.

keyStorylines.title: Spider-Verse
keyStorylines.synopsis: Every spider-hero across the Marvel Multiverse unites under Peter Parker's leadership to battle the vampiric Inheritors hunting totems across dimensions.

characters.name: Anthony Edward 'Tony' Stark
characters.quote: I am Iron Man. The suit and I are one.

comicDebut.creators: Stan Lee, Larry Lieber, Don Heck & Jack Kirby

characters.biography: Anthony Stark, visionary industrialist and prodigal mechanical engineering genius, inherited Stark Industries at age twenty-one. While demonstrating new weaponry overseas, Stark was critically wounded by shrapnel lodged near his heart and captured by enemy forces. Defying captors demanding he build a doomsday weapon, Tony collaborated with fellow captive Dr. Ho Yinsen to forge an electromechanical suit of armor powered by an Arc chest unit. Surviving his escape, Stark refined the Iron Man platform, founding the Avengers and using his fortune and mind to safeguard civilization.
powers: Superhuman Strength & Supersonic Flight via Powered Armor
Advanced On-board AI (F.R.I.D.A.Y. / J.A.R.V.I.S.) & Deflector Forcefields
Modular Specialized Armor Systems (Hulkbuster, Stealth, Space)

keyStorylines.title: Demon in a Bottle
keyStorylines.synopsis: Tony confronts his most treacherous enemy not in armor, but within his own human vulnerability, battling alcoholism while Justin Hammer tampers with the suit.

keyStorylines.title: Armor Wars
keyStorylines.synopsis: Discovering his proprietary technology has been stolen and weaponized by villains and government agents alike, Tony embarks on a rogue crusade to reclaim and neutralize every trace of his armor designs.

keyStorylines.title: Extremis
keyStorylines.synopsis: Confronted by an enhanced terrorist bio-weapon, Stark injects himself with modified Extremis nanotechnology, fusing his nervous system directly into the inner undersheath of his armor.

keyStorylines.title: Civil War
keyStorylines.synopsis: In the wake of the Stamford tragedy, Stark champions the Superhuman Registration Act, sparking an ideological war with Captain America that fragments the heroic community.

characters.name: James 'Logan' Howlett
characters.tagline: The Best There Is At What He Does
characters.quote: I'm the best there is at what I do, but what I do best isn't very nice.

comicDebut.creators: Len Wein, Roy Thomas & John Romita Sr.

characters.biography: Born in late 19th-century Alberta, Canada as James Howlett, the mutant known as Logan possesses enhanced animalistic senses, razor-sharp bone claws, and a miraculous regenerative healing factor allowing him to survive virtually any trauma. Kidnapped by the covert Department K 'Weapon X' program, Logan's skeleton and claws were forcibly bonded with Adamantium—the virtually indestructible alloy. Escaping into the wild and later recruited by Charles Xavier, Wolverine became the fierce soul of the X-Men, forever wrestling with the feral beast within.
powers: Superhumanly Acute Animal Senses (Tracking, Night Vision)
Centuries of Master Martial Arts & Covert Warfare

keyStorylines.title: Days of Future Past
keyStorylines.synopsis: In an apocalyptic future where mutantkind has been herded into concentration camps and slaughtered by Sentinels, Wolverine and the surviving resistance fight a desperate last stand.

keyStorylines.title: Wolverine (Weapon X Origin)
keyStorylines.synopsis: Barry Windsor-Smith's visceral masterpiece detailing Logan's brutal abduction, laboratory torture, and bonding of Adamantium to his skeleton.

keyStorylines.title: Old Man Logan
keyStorylines.synopsis: Fifty years after the supervillains united and conquered America, a pacified Logan is drawn across a ruined wasteland for one final bloody reckoning.

keyStorylines.title: Death of Wolverine
keyStorylines.synopsis: Stripped of his healing factor by an alien virus, Logan is hunted by bounty hunters before sacrificing himself by encasing himself in molten Adamantium to prevent new weaponizations.

characters.name: Ororo Munroe
characters.quote: I am a woman, a mutant, a thief, an X-Man, a lover, a wife, a queen. I am all these things. I am Storm, and for me, there are no limits.
characters.biography: Descendant of an ancient line of African priestesses, Ororo Munroe was orphaned in Cairo after an aerial bombing crushed her home, trapping her under debris and instilling a lifelong claustrophobia. Surviving as a street thief, she wandered south into the Serengeti, where her mutant abilities to control ambient meteorological patterns manifested, leading local tribes to revere her as a living goddess. Recruited into Xavier's new international X-Men team, Storm emerged as one of the most formidable leaders, monarchs, and Omega-level forces in the Marvel cosmos.
powers: Generation of Category-5 Hurricanes, Blizzards & Lightning Bolts
Flight via Atmospheric Thermal Wind Currents
Galactic Solar Wind & Cosmic Pressure Control

keyStorylines.title: Lifedeath
keyStorylines.synopsis: After being stripped of her mutant powers by a neutralizer gun, Ororo stays with Forge and discovers her unshakeable inner resilience and leadership without elemental magic.

keyStorylines.title: Duel with Callisto
keyStorylines.synopsis: Without using her weather powers, Storm battles Morlock leader Callisto in knife combat underground, claiming leadership of the Morlocks through pure martial courage.

keyStorylines.title: X-Men: Red & The Regent of Sol
keyStorylines.synopsis: During the terraforming of Mars into planet Arakko, Storm is recognized as the Voice of Sol, mastering planetary governance while defending the solar system from cosmic warlords.

keyStorylines.title: Blood Hunt: Storm
keyStorylines.synopsis: Ororo steps onto the global stage as Earth's premier protector during a mystical vampire eclipse, proving her authority extends far beyond the mutant sphere.

characters.name: Stephen Vincent Strange, M.D.
characters.tagline: Master of the Mystic Arts & Sorcerer Supreme
characters.quote: We never lose our demons, we only learn to live above them.
characters.biography: Once a brilliant yet arrogant world-renowned neurosurgeon, Stephen Strange lost the use of his delicate surgical hands following a catastrophic car accident. Expending his entire fortune on fruitless medical procedures, Strange traveled to Kamar-Taj in the Himalayas seeking a miraculous cure. Taken under the tutelage of the Ancient One, Stephen looked past his ego to study the sacred esoteric arts. Ascending to the mantle of Earth's Sorcerer Supreme, Doctor Strange guards our dimension against Eldritch horrors, extra-dimensional conquerors, and nightmare entities.
powers: Master of Eldritch Magic & Dimensional Manipulation
Relic Mastery (Eye of Agamotto, Cloak of Levitation, Book of the Vishanti)
Spells of the Vishanti, Crimson Bands of Cyttorak, Flames of the Faltine

keyStorylines.title: The Eternity Saga
keyStorylines.synopsis: Steve Ditko's psychedelic triumph wherein Strange battles Baron Mordo and Dormammu across surreal geometric planes, culminating in a meeting with Eternity itself.

keyStorylines.title: The Oath
keyStorylines.synopsis: When Wong is diagnosed with terminal brain cancer, Strange embarks on an intense hunt for an ancient panacea, uncovering corporate pharmaceutical corruption and confronting an assassin's silver bullet.

keyStorylines.title: Triumph and Torment
keyStorylines.issues: Graphic Novel by Roger Stern & Mike Mignola
keyStorylines.synopsis: Strange allies with Doctor Doom to journey straight into the nether-realms of Mephisto to liberate the soul of Doom's mother, testing both sorcerers' souls.

keyStorylines.title: The Death of Doctor Strange
keyStorylines.synopsis: Earth's dimensional barrier collapses when Doctor Strange is murdered in the Sanctum Sanctorum, prompting a time-displaced younger Stephen Strange to solve his own death.

characters.name: Thanos of Titan
characters.quote: The universe required correction. After that, the sun rises on a grateful universe.
characters.biography: Born on Saturn's moon Titan to Mentor and Sui-San of the Eternals, Thanos was afflicted with the Deviant Syndrome, causing him to be born with dark purple, rugged hide and massive stature. Endowed with incredible natural intellect and strength, Thanos grew isolated and obsessed with nihilism, eventually falling in love with the physical embodiment of Mistress Death. To win her affection, the Mad Titan turned his immense scientific intellect toward genocidal conquest, hunting down the Infinity Gems and bringing the entire universe to the brink of extinction.
powers: Titan-Eternal Physiology with Deviant Syndrome Resilience
Wielder of the Infinity Gauntlet (Time, Space, Mind, Soul, Reality, Power)
Cosmic Supergenius in Cybernetics, Bionics & Dimensional Warfare

keyStorylines.title: The Infinity Gauntlet
keyStorylines.synopsis: Uniting all six Infinity Gems upon his gauntlet, Thanos snaps his fingers, wiping out half of all sentient life in the cosmos in an offering to Mistress Death.

keyStorylines.title: Thanos Quest
keyStorylines.synopsis: Jim Starlin's psychological tour de force charting Thanos's methodical, cunning outsmarting of the Elders of the Universe to claim each of the six Infinity Gems.

keyStorylines.title: Annihilation
keyStorylines.synopsis: When Annihilus leads the Annihilation Wave out of the Negative Zone, Thanos acts as a kingmaker and cosmic tactician, shifting alliances in a galaxy-wide war.

keyStorylines.title: Thanos Wins
keyStorylines.synopsis: King Thanos, millions of years in the future, defeats virtually every deity and hero in the universe and summons his younger self to accomplish his final cosmic wish.
